Plot treatment effects across baseline risk

Source: R/plot.R
plot_treatment_effect.Rd

Draws the pooled treatment effect of an androgen receptor pathway inhibitor (ARPI) plus androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) versus placebo plus ADT across the range of baseline risk in which effects were estimated, with its 95% confidence interval. Patients in newdata are marked at their baseline risk.

Usage

plot_treatment_effect(
  newdata = NULL,
  scale = c("ard", "rmst", "hr"),
  model = mhspc_model(),
  show_overall = TRUE,
  show_prediction_interval = FALSE
)

Arguments

newdata

Optional data frame of patients to mark; see check_inputs() for the required columns.

scale

Effect to plot: "ard", additional patients alive at 4 years per 100; "rmst", additional months alive over 4 years; or "hr", the hazard ratio for death on a log scale.

model

An mhspc_model object from mhspc_model().

show_overall

Whether to draw the overall effect across all trial patients as a reference line.

show_prediction_interval

Whether to draw the 95% prediction interval for a new trial population.

Value

Invisibly, a data frame with the plotted curve in display units.

Examples

patient <- data.frame(
  ecog_ps = 0, gleason_score = 9, visceral_metastasis = 0,
  bone_metastases = 8, psa = 45, hemoglobin = 128, albumin = 41,
  alp = 180, ldh = 210
)
plot_treatment_effect(patient)
